features.inspect_text: Each flag is cut to fit precisely against its neighbors. The joints form lines that cross at right angles, a grid drawn in stone.

title: A Cell of Fitted Stone
summary: A small room of fitted stone blocks. The floor is laid in a grid, lines crossing at every intersection.

features.label: a grid scored into the floor
features.inspect_text: Thin lines cross the floor at right angles, forming a pattern of squares. The intersections are marked with small depressions, worn smooth by something placed and removed many times.

title: A Hall of Crossing Paths

title: The Mushroom Grove
summary: A cavern floor choked with pale mushrooms that lean toward a glowing canopy overhead. The air smells of wet earth and something sweet.
inspect_text: Glowing caps bob in the dark. The false sky above shimmers like water seen from below.

title: A Chalked Clearing
summary: A clearing where faint chalk lines—her chalk—glow in the soil. The forest parts here, as if waiting for something.
inspect_text: The lines trace shapes she half-remembers. Something moved here recently.

title: The Root Hollow
summary: Gnarled roots weave through the walls of this hollow, and between them the deep hum of the forest beats like a slow heart.
inspect_text: The hum quickens near the eastern wall, as if something large is sleeping just beyond.
